titleEn: New Westminster Home Renovation Guide 2026: Costs, Contractors & Required Permits
titleZh: 二埠家居装修指南2026：费用、承建商与所需许可证
contentEn:
New Westminster sits at the geographic and psychological heart of Metro Vancouver — squeezed between Burnaby and Richmond, a city of heritage streetscapes, riverside condos, and century-old singl-family homes on the hillside. Its unique urban fabric creates renovation challenges that don't exist in the suburbs. Reno Stars works in New Westminster weekly, and this guide covers what actually matters for 2026.

## Why New Westminster Homeowners Renovate in 2026

Three forces are driving New Westminster renovation demand in 2026:

**Strata-titled inventory**: The city's downtown core — Westminster, Queens, and Brownes — is dominated by highrise and lowrise strata buildings. Strata approval is the single biggest delay factor in New Westminster condo renovations. Every project that touches common property, plumbing, or electrical requires a strata council vote. That vote can take 4–10 weeks. Reno Stars handles the full strata package: drawings, scope of work, insurance certificates, and noise management plans.

**Heritage preservation pressure**: New Westminster's historic housing stock — particularly in the Queen's Park and Connaught Heights neighbourhoods — falls under the city's Heritage Register. Renovating a registered or pre-1940s home triggers Heritage Alteration Permit (HAP) requirements in addition to a building permit. This adds 4–8 weeks to the approval timeline. The HAP does not block renovation; it ensures exterior character elements are preserved.

**Fraser River flood construction requirements**: Properties within the Fraser River flood construction level area (approximately the eastern part of the city near the river) face additional BC Building Code requirements for foundation height and building envelope. This is not a ban on renovation — it is a design constraint that adds engineering requirements.

## New Westminster Renovation Costs 2026

| Project Type | Low | Mid | High |
|---|---|---|---|
| Condo kitchen refresh | $22,000 | $28,000–$38,000 | $55,000 |
| Condo bathroom renovation | $12,000 | $18,000–$28,000 | $40,000 |
| Full condo gut renovation | $45,000 | $60,000–$85,000 | $120,000 |
| Townhouse renovation | $35,000 | $55,000–$90,000 | $150,000 |
| Single-family home renovation | $50,000 | $80,000–$140,000 | $280,000 |
| Heritage home renovation | $70,000 | $110,000–$180,000 | $350,000 |

These are all-in costs including materials, labour, permits, and BC Building Code compliance. Every Reno Stars project includes a fixed-price contract and a written scope before work begins.

## Required Permits in New Westminster

**Building permit**: Required for any structural change, plumbing addition, electrical panel upgrade, and any renovation that changes a building's use or occupancy. New Westminster uses the same BC Building Code (Div. A, B, C, and relevant sections of Division C) as the rest of BC. For renovations in a strata building, the building permit is triggered by the scope of work inside your unit — strata approval runs in parallel.

**Heritage Alteration Permit (HAP)**: Triggered for any exterior change to a property on the Heritage Register or pre-1940s construction. Interior-only renovations to heritage homes typically do not require a HAP. If your home is on the city's Heritage Inventory (not the Register), a HAP may still be required — confirm with the planning department before design.

**Strata approval**: Required for any work affecting common property, or any work that penetrates the unit's envelope (plumbing, electrical, structural). Your renovation contractor should prepare the package; Reno Stars has submitted over 30 strata renovation packages in New Westminster buildings and maintains a track record of approvals.

**Demolition permit**: Required for any work that removes existing fixtures, cabinetry, or structure. A partial demolition permit is required when existing finishes are being removed as part of a renovation.

## Strata Renovations in New Westminster: What to Expect

New Westminster has a higher proportion of active strata councils than any other city in Metro Vancouver per capita. Active councils vote on renovation applications at regular meetings — typically monthly. The minimum timeline from application submission to approved start date is 6–10 weeks, sometimes longer for complex proposals.

What strata councils in New Westminster typically require:
- Detailed scope of work description
- Floor plans showing the work area
- Contractor insurance certificate ($5M CGL minimum)
- Proof of City of New Westminster business licence
- Noise management plan for construction hours
- Deposit (refundable, typically $500–$2,000)

Reno Stars includes all of the above in every strata renovation package. We submit complete applications — no missing documents, no council pushback on incomplete packages.

## New Westminster Neighbourhoods We Serve

- **Queen's Park**: Heritage homes, early 20th century character houses. Heritage Alteration Permit likely required for exterior changes.
- **Connaught Heights**: Mix of 1920s–1950s homes and newer infill. Good candidate for whole-house renovations.
- **Downtown New Westminster (Westminster Centre, Queens, Brownes)**: Dense condo inventory. Kitchen and bathroom renovations are the dominant scope.
- **Sapperton**: Industrial heritage meets modern development. Good for commercial tenant improvements and warehouse-to-residential conversions.
- **Fraserwood and other West side neighbourhoods**: Primarily single-family homes. Larger renovation scopes.
- **New Westminster waterfront / Westminster Pier Park area**: Premium condo renovations with views. High-spec finishes are common.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need a Heritage Alteration Permit for interior-only renovations in Queen's Park?**
No — a HAP is only required when the work affects the exterior of a heritage-registered building. Interior-only work in a heritage home in New Westminster requires a building permit but not a HAP. Structural changes still require engineering.

**How long does a New Westminster condo renovation take from first meeting to completion?**
A typical timeline: initial consultation and quote (1–2 weeks), strata approval (6–10 weeks if needed), building permit (3–6 weeks for a standard renovation), construction (4–12 weeks depending on scope). Total: 14–30 weeks.

**Can Reno Stars submit the strata application for me?**
Yes. We prepare the full package — drawings, scope description, insurance, noise plan, and business licence documentation — and submit directly to the strata council on your behalf.

**What is the flood construction level in New Westminster?**
The Fraser River flood construction level affects properties in the eastern portion of New Westminster near the riverfront. The minimum habitable floor elevation is set by the City and BC Building Code. If you are planning a basement renovation in this area, a geotechnical or structural engineer must confirm the existing foundation meets current requirements.

contentZh:
二埠（New Westminster）位于大温哥华地区的地理与社区中心地带——夹在本拿比与列治文之间，这座城市融合了传统街道景观、滨河公寓以及山坡上的百年独立屋。独特的城市结构带来了郊区住宅不存在的装修挑战。聚星装修每周在二埠开展工程，本指南涵盖2026年真正需要了解的内容。

## 为什么二埠业主在2026年选择装修

三大驱动力推动二埠装修需求：

**分层物业库存**：二埠市中心核心区——Westminster、Queens和Brownes——以高层和低层分层建筑物为主。二埠公寓装修中最大的延误因素是分层审批。每个涉及公共财产、管道或电气的项目都需要分层委员会投票。该投票可能需要4至10周。聚星装修处理完整的分层审批文件包：图纸、工程范围、保险证书和噪音管理计划。

**历史保护压力**：二埠的历史住宅存量——尤其是Queens Park和Connaught Heights社区——受到城市历史遗迹登记册的约束。装修登记在册或1940年代以前建造的房屋，除了建筑许可证外，还需要历史变更许可证（HAP）。这会使审批时间增加4至8周。HAP不会阻止装修，只是确保外观特色得到保护。

**菲沙河洪水建设要求**：位于菲沙河洪水建设水平区域（城市东部靠近河流的区域）的房产，面临额外的卑诗省建筑规范对地基高度和建筑围护结构的要求。这不是装修的禁令，而是一项增加工程要求的设计约束。

## 二埠装修费用 2026

| 项目类型 | 低价 | 中价 | 高价 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 公寓厨房翻新 | $22,000 | $28,000–$38,000 | $55,000 |
| 公寓浴室装修 | $12,000 | $18,000–$28,000 | $40,000 |
| 公寓全拆翻新 | $45,000 | $60,000–$85,000 | $120,000 |
| 联排别墅装修 | $35,000 | $55,000–$90,000 | $150,000 |
| 独立屋装修 | $50,000 | $80,000–$140,000 | $280,000 |
| 历史房屋装修 | $70,000 | $110,000–$180,000 | $350,000 |

以上均为全包价格，涵盖材料、人工、许可证及卑诗省建筑规范合规。每个聚星装修项目均包含固定价格合同和开工前书面工程范围。

## 二埠所需的许可证

**建筑许可证**：任何结构变更、管道增设、电气配电箱升级以及改变建筑物用途或占用的装修均需要。对于分层建筑物内的装修，建筑许可证的触发取决于您单元内工程的范围——分层审批并行进行。

**历史变更许可证（HAP）**：任何对历史遗迹登记册上物业的外观变更都会触发HAP，或对1940年代以前建造的房屋的外观变更也会触发。历史房屋的室内装修通常不需要HAP。如果您的房屋在市历史清单（而非登记册）上，可能仍需要HAP——装修前请向规划部门确认。

**分层审批**：任何影响公共财产的工程，或穿透单元围护结构的工程（管道、电气、结构）均需要审批。您的装修承包商应准备文件包；聚星装修已在二埠建筑物提交了超过30份分层装修文件包，保持审批通过记录。

**拆除许可证**：任何拆除现有固定装置、橱柜或结构的工程均需要。装修中拆除现有饰面时，需要部分拆除许可证。

## 二埠分层物业装修：预期流程

二埠每千人拥有的活跃分层委员会比例高于大温哥华其他任何城市。活跃委员会在例会上对装修申请进行投票——通常每月一次。从提交申请到批准开工的最短时间线为6至10周，复杂方案可能更长。

二埠分层委员会通常要求：
- 详细的工程范围描述
- 显示工程区域的平面图
- 承包商保险证书（最低$500万综合责任险）
- 二埠市商业执照证明
- 施工时间噪音管理计划
- 押金（可退还，通常$500至$2,000）

聚星装修在每个分层物业装修文件包中均包含以上全部内容。我们提交完整申请——无文件缺失，委员会不会因文件包不完整而提出异议。

## 我们服务的二埠社区

- **Queens Park**：历史住宅，早期20世纪特色房屋。外观变更可能需要历史变更许可证。
- **Connaught Heights**：1920年代至1950年代住宅与新填充建筑的混合区。全屋装修的绝佳选择。
- **二埠市中心（Westminster Centre、Queens、Brownes）**：高密度公寓库存。厨房和浴室装修是主要工程范围。
- **Sapperton**：工业历史与现代开发交汇。适合商业租户改善工程和仓库转住宅改造。
- **Fraserwood及其他西区社区**：主要为独立屋。装修工程范围更大。
- **二埠滨河/Westminster Pier Park区域**：带景观的优质公寓装修。通常使用高端饰面。

## 常见问题

**Queens Park历史房屋室内装修是否需要历史变更许可证？**
不需要——只有当工程影响历史登记建筑的外观时，才需要HAP。二埠历史房屋的室内装修只需建筑许可证，不需要HAP。结构变更仍需要工程设计。

**二埠公寓装修从首次洽谈到完工需要多长时间？**
典型时间线：初步咨询和报价（1至2周）、分层审批（如需要，6至10周）、建筑许可证（标准装修3至6周）、施工（4至12周，取决于工程范围）。总计：14至30周。

**聚星装修可以代表我提交分层申请吗？**
可以。我们准备完整文件包——图纸、工程范围描述、保险、噪音计划和商业执照文件——并直接代表您向分层委员会提交。

**二埠的洪水建设水平是多少？**
菲沙河洪水建设水平影响二埠东部靠近河滨的物业。最低宜居地板标高由市和卑诗省建筑规范设定。如果您计划在该区域进行地下室装修，岩土或结构工程师必须确认现有地基符合当前要求。
